meta.title: Barrett's Trusted Vendors
meta.description: Title companies, insurance, and home service providers Barrett Henry has worked with directly. Not a paid directory.
meta.source: Each company's own website, verified individually
meta.disclaimer: Barrett Henry receives no referral fees from any provider on this page. These are companies he has worked with directly. Clients should independently verify licensing, insurance, and current pricing before hiring anyone.

title_companies.name: Lakeland Title
title_companies.bio: Where I send Polk County closings. Family owned and operated. Ask for Mallory Gillum.

title_companies.name: Milestone Title Services
title_companies.address: 431 Apollo Beach Blvd, Apollo Beach, FL 33572
title_companies.bio: South Hillsborough closings, convenient for Apollo Beach, Ruskin and Sun City Center transactions.

title_companies.name: Coastal Collective Title
title_companies.bio: Florida title, escrow and settlement services. Orders at orders@coastalcollectivetitle.com.

insurance.name: Park Insurance
insurance.address: 231 N Kentucky Ave, Suite 201, Lakeland, FL 33801
insurance.bio: Allstate affiliated agency that also brokers other carriers, which matters in the current Florida market. Ask for Bryce McDonald.

home_services.name: Tampa Bay Appliance Repair
home_services.bio: Serves Tampa, Brandon, Lutz, Thonotosassa, Wesley Chapel and Lakeland. Useful when an inspection flags an appliance days before closing.

home_services.name: D & D Garage Doors
home_services.bio: Garage door repair and replacement across the Tampa and St. Pete area. Wind-rated door replacement can also affect an insurance wind mitigation credit.

home_services.name: Best Bay Services
home_services.bio: Handyman and ongoing property maintenance. Disclosure: this company is owned by a member of my family.
home_services.note: Owned by a member of Barrett's family. Disclosed so you can weigh the recommendation accordingly.
